status: Source-inspected API and constraints; no common checker or product execution

existing_apis.input: Original pipeline Cursor, named InputContract owners, supplied parameter declarations/profiles/ModelTasks and existing bounded Limits
existing_apis.retain: InputContract original admission handle, producer keys/order/literals/window/delta/ranking and outstanding validation/resource obligations
existing_apis.boundary: Static checking is not data validation, permission to acquire, a physical reservation, or Program/Plan/Run publication.

existing_apis.output: Conditional successful ProducedInput owner retaining carrier/evidence/debts
existing_apis.retain: Immutable producer pipeline and target, not a frontend reconstructed schema, count or uniqueness assertion
existing_apis.boundary: Use only an actual common-issued producer. Binding or scope wrappers add no projection/normalization.

existing_apis.input: ProducedInput, SourceViewInput, CarrierInput or existing explicit evidence variants
existing_apis.retain: SourceViewInput retains Stage, declaration name, original declaration Cursor and common SourceViewCarrier
existing_apis.boundary: check_impl requires the pipeline Cursor to be that Stage's steps and the retained declaration to belong to its inputs. Never forge a new fragment owner by copying a schema or reusing a stale Cursor.

frontend_change.current_rule: Unused declarations are refused because the frontend cannot yet perform complete checking without acquisition scheduling.
frontend_change.target: Resolve and statically lower every authored binding against supplied metadata/common contracts, then emit only final/explicit Result/Effect reachable bindings. Keep semantic argument occurrences separate from deduplicated reachability edges.
do_not: Delete the unused-refusal check before replacing its complete semantic checking responsibility.
Execute a Source or Model to discover a schema.
Promote structural CarrierInput to key/provenance evidence.
Reinterpret checked conditional evidence as successful dynamic validation.
Issue a synthetic public Program/Run to check a dead declaration.
Drop earlier explicit Result/Effect obligations or dynamic assertions inside a demanded body.

concrete_controls.source: WITH unused AS (SELECT id FROM records) SELECT 1 AS id
concrete_controls.expected: supplied schema permits full static checking; unused Source I/O zero

concrete_controls.source: WITH unused AS (SELECT missing FROM records) SELECT 1 AS id
concrete_controls.expected: unresolved field before Program issuance/provider I/O
duplicate complete Graph key remains a pending dynamic obligation when unused; the existing common owner refuses it when demanded
missing metadata, invisible metadata and explicit static denial remain distinct internal causes; public non-disclosure follows current policy

remaining: Actual binding lowerer and temporary syntax-owner lifetime must be implemented after integrated main adoption. If an existing admission API is insufficient, record the minimal Cursor/input contract and exact common refusal before proposing a finite common extension; do not claim the source inspection establishes complete admission.
